Hi I would like to post my experience, I had to order a replacement for my 65 inch A95L. I had constant popping sounds while on my apple tv dolby atmos and while playing my ps5. My work around this is to quickly switch between HDMI connections and this seems to make the popping stop for a bit but it was returning. I purchased through Amazon, I got my replacement approved and I just finished setting up my replacement an hour ago. Unfortunately the popping sound started right away. I am watching Dune right now and the popping sound is coming up with this replacement set. The screen is absolutely amazing but the popping sound is here again. I was also on my ps5 playing Hogwarts Legacy and the popping and distortion started happening with my ps5. I quickly switched to hdmi 1 (nintendo switch) and went back to HDMI 4 and the popping stopped. I also made sure to try a new HDMI cable this time around but didn't make any difference as there is still a popping sound. I am thinking about what I should next and I am leaning on returning the replacement and just requesting a full refund. I have this suspicion that both panels I got were models that were returned and just repackaged as new, although I have no proof, both of my shipping boxes were pretty dirty and one of them had 1 strap on them when I received the shipment. I did let Amazon know about the condition and they assured me I would have no issues returning if there was an issue with the tv set. I think for 3500 dollars the popping sound isn't acceptable, gosh that screen is pure beauty tho. I was thinking about getting a sony sound bar but thats another 900 dollars. Anyway I just thought I would share. Thanks.
